u0: At the start the agent has not yet located the key and the locked door guarding the ball is still closed. The overall objective is to pick up the mission ball; since the key has not been seen, no promise to open the locked door is outstanding yet. Normal exploration toward the key or the ball may continue without penalty.
u1: The mission ball has been picked up, so the task is complete and the episode ends successfully. If the key had been located earlier, the locked door was opened by this point, satisfying the added requirement.
u2: The locked door guarding the target room has been opened, either after the key was found or along the way, but the ball has not yet been picked up. The remaining objective is simply to enter the target room and pick up the ball.
u3: The agent has located the key, so it is now committed to opening the locked door guarding the target room. Remaining work is to obtain and use that key to open the door and then pick up the ball; if the ball is picked up before the door is opened, the door must still be opened afterward. This is the most demanding stage, with the finding of the key charged as a slight penalty.
u4: The key was found and the ball has been picked up, but because of the promise to open the locked door, the task does not finish until that door has been opened. The only remaining objective is to open the locked door guarding the target room; once it opens, the task is complete.
